description:
An HR 'Annual Employee Climate Monitor 2025' survey has been reported to have broken branching logic. Your task is to troubleshoot and fix three specific logic errors using the Logic File check or visual inspection. 

1. The 'Remote Work Tools' group is not showing up when it should. It seems to reference a variable 'work_style' that doesn't exist (the actual question code is 'work_mode'). Fix the group relevance equation.
2. The 'Sales Targets' question has a syntax error in its condition (unclosed quote). Fix the question relevance equation.
3. The 'Shift Preferences' question logic is behaving unexpectedly. It uses a single equals sign '=' instead of the comparison operator '=='. Fix the question relevance equation.

Log in with admin/Admin123!, navigate to the survey (Annual Employee Climate Monitor 2025), use 'Check Survey Logic' to find the errors, and correct them in the group/question settings.
